'''Benna Lodd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], where she could be found selling [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to other hunters on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

She worn set of golden [[Republic trooper]] armor and a [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian helmet]].

==Behind the scenes==
Benna Lodd appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the PvP Warzone Gear Vendor for the Bounty Hunter class on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" /> She was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
